purpose: Teach: 農政/国民党/生育/深層/重度/照射/同和/音程

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦後の農政改革史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on postwar agricultural reform policy, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Gentle confirmation — she's read the work. Pause before the topic, inviting her into the detail. Steady eye contact, encouraging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、台湾国民党の戦後政治史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the postwar political history of the Taiwanese Nationalist Party.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Pride in the specificity without showing off. Slight pause before the topic — she's chosen something precise. Confident but not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 植物の生育環境研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper on plant growth and environmental conditions — that was interesting work too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Slight lean back, genuinely considering the scope of her work. Not rushing. Recognition without pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、海洋深層水の利用研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper focused on research into the applications of deep ocean water.
lines.style: Steady and matter-of-fact. She's correcting the frame gently. No defensiveness — just clarity. Direct eye contact, speaking from knowledge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 重度の難病患者の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your research into patients with severe rare diseases — that took real commitment.
lines.style: Genuine recognition. Warmer now. She's acknowledging not just the academic work but the emotional weight. Slower pace, more presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、紫外線照射の皮膚影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my research was specifically on the skin effects of ultraviolet radiation exposure.
lines.style: Confident, grounded in specifics. Small steady voice — she knows what she studied. No apology for the precision. Clear finish.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の同和教育史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And postwar history of dowa education — that's significant material.
lines.style: Reflective, measuring the importance. Slower cadence. Not performative, but genuinely registering the gravity of the topic. Open and waiting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、合唱の音程訓練を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper was about pitch training techniques in choral music.
lines.style: Clear closing. Steady voice without apology. She's been gently corrected three times and remains unshaken. Slight finality — the list is complete.
